In this special episode of The Ranveer Show , we are joined by Vinay Varanasi, who shares deep insights on Ganesh Chaturthi, Sanatan Dharma, Spirituality, Hinduism, Upasana, Tantra, and important Life Lessons. This episode takes you into the stories of Lord Ganesha, his symbolism, and his spiritual significance.

In this conversation with Vinay Varanasi, we talk about the Story of Ganesha’s Birth, Importance of Ganesh Chaturthi, Mantras, Shlokas, and Spiritual Practices. We also understand how Ganesha teaches us to surrender our ego, trust divinity, and overcome obstacles gracefully.

This episode also covers the Meaning of Puja, Role of Time in Spirituality, Tantra as a Technical Process, Ganesha as Vighna Harta & Vighna Karta, and the Importance of Festivals in Sanatan Dharma.

This Hindi podcast is a valuable resource for anyone interested in Spiritual Journey, Hinduism, Ganesh Chaturthi Rituals, Personal Growth, and Sanatan Dharma.

Keep watching such Hindi podcasts only on your favourite BeerBiceps Hindi Channel Ranveer Allahbadia.

(00:00) - Introduction & Divine Favorite
(01:47)  - Opening Mantra & Meaning
(04:51)  - The Story of Ganesha's Emergence
(06:45) - Why Divinity Appears in a Child's Form
(13:33) - The Symbolism of Ganesha's Form
(23:34) - The True Meaning of Puja & Making an Idol
(35:40)  - Ganapatya & Six Schools of Dharma
(51:49) - Ganesha's Role During Life's Chaotic Times
(1:03:25) - The Energy of Joy: Ganesha & Hanuman
(1:06:20) -  Ganesha & Kartikeya

In this video, Chandan Kumar Sir introduces the PSIR Optional Paper 2 Foundation 2027 and explains his structured approach to Comparative Politics, International Relations and India's Foreign Policy.

Learn how Paper 2A and Paper 2B will be taught through an integrated approach, connecting overlapping topics with contemporary global developments. The program focuses on conceptual clarity, current affairs integration, UPSC PYQ discussions, printed notes, answer writing and regular tests to make PSIR Paper 2 preparation more systematic.

🌐 Enroll in PSIR Paper-2 Foundation 2027: https://shorturl.at/YWP21

📞 For Enquiries: 8826496658

Program Highlights:
✅ Comprehensive PSIR Paper 2 Coverage
✅ Integrated Paper 2A & 2B Approach
✅ Current Affairs & Contemporary Examples
✅ PYQ Discussions (2013 Onwards)
✅ Printed Class Notes
✅ 4+ Class Tests & Interactive Discussions

📅 Batch Starts: 16 November 2026

⏱️ Chapters
